verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing copy about AI features, graphics, and gaming, with no documented PCIe generation/lane counts, storage interface specs, or external connectivity (Thunderbolt/USB) details that a developer could plan a build or dock setup around. This axis clearly applies to a CPU platform, but no supporting evidence exists in the pack — missing for 10: PCIe lane/generation specs, storage interface details, Thunderbolt/USB connectivity specs, official ARK I/O tables.
